question: Aconcagua Oil & Extract S.A. manufacturer
markdown:
Aconcagua Oil & Extract S.A.
is a
private food manufacturing company located in San Felipe, Valparaíso, Chile
. The company specializes in processing regional avocados into cold-pressed and extra virgin oils, most notably producing the
Paltita
brand of avocado oil.
Company Overview
Location
: San Felipe, Valparaíso Region, Chile
Core Product
: Extra virgin, cold-pressed avocado oil (Paltita brand)
Product Traits
: No additives, cholesterol-free, high in monounsaturated fats, and rich in vitamin E
Industry
: Food and beverage manufacturing, bulk and retail oil production
